meta.title: Self-hosted media management and processing

hero.title: Your media, under your control.

origins.archived: The project is archived: its origins cannot be changed until it is restored.

origins.removeDescription: Pages on this site will no longer be able to call the project's API from a browser.

add.label: Origin
add.hint: Scheme and host, with the port if needed, without a path.

tokens.title: Personal tokens
tokens.description: For your scripts, tools and integrations: a token acts with your permissions, on the projects you choose.
tokens.notice: A token never exceeds your permissions: if you leave a project, your role changes or your account is deactivated, it loses the matching access. It cannot manage members, keys or settings.
tokens.loadError: Unable to load your personal tokens.
tokens.caption: Active personal tokens

revoke.title: Revoke the “{name}” token?
revoke.description: Scripts and tools using it lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete the “{name}” token?
delete.description: It disappears from this list; the audit log keeps a record of it.

inactive.summary: No revoked or expired token | One revoked or expired token | {count} revoked or expired tokens

revealed.title: Token “{name}” created
revealed.description: Send it in the Authorization: Bearer header of your requests, from a terminal, CI or script — never from a web page.
revealed.label: Personal token

new.title: New personal token
new.description: Give it only the access it needs; you can revoke it at any time.
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: To recognise it: its intended use (e.g. Import script, CI).
new.lifetimeHint: A personal token always expires; create a new one when it does.

all.label: All my projects
all.description: Every project you can access, including those you join later.

access.noProjects: You do not have access to any active project.
access.libraryHint: The token can also act on media in the library.
access.libraryReadHint: The token will also read the library media (your role only allows browsing it).

new.notice: The token will be shown only once. You may be asked for your password.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings shared by the whole installation.

transforms.title: Image transformations
transforms.description: Free transformations of library media, presets shared by every project and server limits.

transforms.projectDescription: Project images are transformed through their delivery address: size, crop, format, quality. Choose what is allowed and define reusable presets.
transforms.loadError: Unable to load the transformation settings.

policy.title: Free transformations

description.project: A free transformation describes the result in the image address (e.g. w_800,h_450,q_70). Presets are always served.
description.installation: A free transformation describes the result in the image address (e.g. w_800,h_450,q_70). This setting applies to library media; each project has its own. Presets are always served.

OPEN.label: Open
OPEN.description: Any transformation, within the server limits (size, number of variants, rate). Handy for a public site building its responsive images.

SIGNED.label: Signed
SIGNED.description: Free parameters require an address signed by your server or an API credential. Presets stay open.

PRESETS.label: Presets only
PRESETS.description: Only presets are served: you control exactly which files are generated.

policy.readOnly: Only project owners can change this setting.

presets.title: Presets
presets.usage: A preset is used by its name in an image address: {url}. The format is given by the extension (jpg, png, webp, avif).
presets.dialogDescription: Fields left empty keep the original image. An image is never enlarged.
presets.deleteDescription: Addresses using it will no longer serve an image (404 error).
presets.deleteRevealsGlobal: Addresses using it will serve the global preset with the same name again.
presets.fullDescription: Whole image, re-encoded in the requested format.

builtin.full: Format conversion only, without metadata (EXIF, GPS).

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; it appears in image addresses.
fields.renameHint: Renaming changes the address of the images using it.
fields.backgroundHint: Six hexadecimal digits (ffffff = white). Colours the “Contain” bars and replaces transparency in JPEG; empty = transparent, or white in JPEG.
fields.widthHint: Empty: derived from the height, proportions kept. {max} px at most.
fields.heightHint: Empty: derived from the width, proportions kept. {max} px at most.

limits.title: Server limits
limits.description: Set by the server NUXT_MEDIA_TRANSFORM_* environment variables.

errors.PRESET_NAME_TAKEN: A preset already has this name at this level.
errors.INVALID_TRANSFORM: The server does not accept this value.

fieldGroups.sizeHelp: Leave both fields empty to keep the original size. The image is never enlarged.
fieldGroups.framingUnavailable: Enter a width and a height to choose how the image fills that frame.

fitHelp.cover: The image fills the whole frame; what goes beyond is cut around the anchor.
fitHelp.contain: The whole image fits in the frame; the empty bars take the background colour.
fitHelp.fill: The image is stretched to the exact dimensions, without keeping its proportions.
fitHelp.inside: The whole image fits in the frame, without bars: the result may be smaller than the frame on one side.
fitHelp.outside: The image covers the whole frame without being cut: the result may exceed the frame on one side.

gravityHelp.focal: The focal point of the image stays in the frame (the center when none is set).
gravityHelp.center: The center of the image stays in the frame.
gravityHelp.attention: The most striking area (contrast, vivid colours), detected automatically.
gravityHelp.entropy: The most detailed area, detected automatically.
gravityHelp.edge: The crop keeps this part of the image: {position}.

qualityHelp.format: 1 to 100. Empty: default quality for {format} ({quality}). Lower = lighter file.
qualityHelp.png: PNG: lossless when empty; a quality (1 to 100) reduces the colour palette for a lighter file.
qualityHelp.any: 1 to 100. Empty: default quality of the format (80 for JPEG and WebP, 50 for AVIF; lossless PNG).
